verdicts.explanation: The paper states Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 (Cl1.5) has an ionic conductivity of 4.5 mS cm−1, and the Methods EIS section states conductivity was measured at 298 K on the synthesized electrolytes. Synthesis (ball milling plus annealing), null sintering fields, and the 'total' kind (from total resistance R) all match the paper.

The paper states Li6PS5Cl (Cl1.0) has 2.3 mS cm−1, measured by EIS at 298 K per the Methods, on the synthesized electrolytes. Synthesis method, null sintering fields, and 'total' conductivity kind are all consistent with the paper.
